# unifi_setting_device_management (Resource)

Manage the toggles of a site's device management settings, the legacy local Network API setting `mgmt`: whether the UniFi devices accept SSH, whether they accept the SSH password, and automatic firmware updates. The SSH username, password, password hash and keys, and the controller's API and management keys, are deliberately not modelled: they never reach Terraform state, and every write sends them back unchanged, except that each write to `mgmt` makes the controller regenerate its `x_api_token`, even when no value changes, so every apply that changes this resource rotates that token. Set them in the UI. The setting exists once per site: the resource takes over the existing document, or creates it on a site that has never saved it, and changes only the configured fields. Each write sends the document back whole, to preserve the fields it doesn't model, so a field that was absent can become empty but never absent again. Import with `<site_id>`. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

# SSH to the devices with keys only; firmware updates at 03:00. The SSH username, password and
# keys are set in the UI and never reach Terraform state.
resource "unifi_setting_device_management" "default" {
  site_id                   = data.unifi_site.default.id
  ssh_enabled               = true
  ssh_password_auth_enabled = false
  auto_upgrade              = true
  auto_upgrade_hour         = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.
- `ssh_enabled` (Boolean) SSH access to the site's UniFi devices (device authentication).

### Optional

- `auto_upgrade` (Boolean) Update the devices' firmware automatically. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `auto_upgrade_hour` (Number) Hour of the day (0 to 23, in the site's time zone) for automatic firmware updates. Keeps the controller's value when not set.
- `ssh_password_auth_enabled` (Boolean) Allow SSH logins to the devices with the password; with `false`, only the configured SSH keys work. Keeps the controller's value when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic resource ID equal to `site_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The setting exists once per site: import with the integration site UUID.
terraform import unifi_setting_device_management.default <site_id>
```
